source.name: Casa Cedo official hotel website
source.rightsEvidence: The requester attested on 2026-09-25 that clearance covers full-page screenshot retention, derived design prompts, and submitting screenshot evidence to the LaunchLoom pipeline model as visual reference. No source-owner grant file was attached.

provenance.method: Rendered the direct official domain in an isolated agent-browser Chromium session; captured full-page desktop and mobile screenshots after scrolling the full page and decoding all source images. No gallery screenshot or source media file was downloaded. The visible cookie notice was dismissed using its consent control before final capture.
provenance.diagnostics: All 17 images decoded at both capture sizes; zero broken images; document width matched 1440px desktop and 390px mobile. The source has very large editorial whitespace and duplicated carousel imagery; the mobile capture preserves the actual page rhythm rather than clipping it.
provenance.attribution: Casa Cedo official site. Captures and derived mechanics brief are internal/model visual references only under requester attestation; source assets are not client deliverables.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A boutique hotel site tells a long-form story about a lived-in house: the opening is a cinematic warm interior with a small wordmark/nav; a compact welcome follows on warm ivory; restoration details alternate with small photos and short story fragments; testimonials/interior quotations punctuate a longer host narrative; a room/experience strip previews the property; and a terracotta footer hosts navigation, booking and contacts. Mobile retains the story sequence but compresses some intervals and stacks scenes.

heroGeometry.mode: full-bleed intimate warm interior photograph with centered short statement
heroGeometry.alignment: quiet wordmark and booking utility at top; the headline rests in open space within the room image
heroGeometry.viewport: opening shows hotel identity, destination positioning and a single book-stay action

navigationGeometry.mode: minimal wordmark with room/experience navigation and a booking action
navigationGeometry.placement: top overlay against the opening image
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact utility header with a visible book action and accessible menu

typography.scale: small uppercase labels, carefully sized hero sentence, narrow long-form story measure, quiet captions

palette.contrastIntent: soft hospitality palette with readable text and booking controls

imageTreatment.mode: authentic interior, restoration/object detail, garden and room scenes
imageTreatment.crop: full-bleed opening plus alternating small and large narrative image blocks
imageTreatment.focalPoint: room architecture, material and sense of place

servicePresentation.pattern: rooms and real property experiences as a compact browseable strip, supported by editorial chapters
servicePresentation.interaction: direct booking/room links and optional accessible horizontal gallery

ctaPlacement.primary: Book your stay in opening navigation and hero
ctaPlacement.early: within first view, before longer story content

motion.primitive: quiet image/story reveal and horizontal room strip navigation
motion.reducedMotion: show all story content in static order; provide video poster where motion exists

rules: alternate copy and images without empty spacer gaps
stack room experiences into clear swipe/stack choices

prohibitedPatterns: copying Casa Cedo brand, exact story, photography or review quotes
inventing room names, rates, occupancy, property history or awards
fake availability, price countdowns or booking confirmation
blank pacing sections that hide missing business information
source reviewers shown as client proof

requiredSignatureElements.description: full-bleed room image with a restrained place-specific promise
alternating image and concise history/material narrative when verified
warm contact footer with direct working booking action

acceptanceChecks: hotel category and destination are stated in visible HTML
all room, date, rate and facility details come from verified client data
booking action leads to the real channel
mobile no longer than necessary while preserving the editorial pacing
gallery captions and navigation work with touch and keyboard
no source asset, copy, logo or claim is reused

review.scope: direct-site paired screenshots, source mechanics prompt, and requester attestation; no owner grant file uploaded
